issue.title: just docs-check fails: docs/develop/decisions.md not regenerated after the open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated decision

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
`docs/develop/decisions.md` is generated from `sase/memory/decisions/`. Commit 134016ce
(epic bob-cli-at phase .7, closed) added the decision strand
`open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated` but did not regenerate the page, so on master 7e3bdb2e:

```
$ just docs-check
bob-docs lint: ok
out of date: docs/develop/decisions.md (run just docs-gen)
docs-check: FAILED (generated drift, exit 1)
```

`grep -c open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated docs/develop/decisions.md` returns 0. Deterministic:
it is a stale generated file, not intermittent. Fix: run `just docs-gen`, review that only
the decisions page changes, and confirm `just docs-check` passes. Found by the bob-cli-an.6
lander. (The six undocumented `BOB_REF_*` controls that bob-cli-an.6.5 reported earlier no
longer fail `bob-docs lint`; 134016ce's docs consolidation covered them.)

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-an.6 lander running just docs-check on master: generated drift left by the closed bob-cli-at landing fails the docs gate.

payload.description: bob-cli-at.7 added the decision strand without regenerating docs

payload.entry: Resolved on master by a08581d8 (13i, 2026-10-23 18:54 EDT), which regenerated docs/develop/decisions.md (+50 lines; grep -c open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated now 1). Lander bob-cli-an.6.6 reran just docs-check on master a08581d8 plus its landing diff: 'generated contract content is up to date', 'docs-check: all implemented gates passed'. Phases bob-cli-an.6.6.3 #1 and bob-cli-an.6.6.4 #4 proposed this same follow-up; routed here and closed as done.
